title: Legal Person Identification Data
description: Legal PID (LPID): identification data for a legal person, issued by a company registration office as authentic source. Defined by EWC WP3.

vct.description: Credential type identifier of the Legal Person Identification Data.

id.description: EUID where available, otherwise a similar constructed, unique per issuer identifier.

name.description: Official name of the EBW owner (economic operator or public sector body).

issuing_authority.description: Name of the administrative authority, Commission (for Union entities), or QTSP issuing the EAA/QEAA; or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 where applicable.

issuing_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the provider’s country/territory.

issuing_authority_id.description: Identifier of the issuing authority (business register identifier, for example as used in BRIS).

issuing_jurisdiction.description: Country subdivision code of the issuing jurisdiction, as defined in ISO 3166-2:2020, Clause 8. The first part of the code is the same as issuing_country.

issuance_date.description: Date and possibly time when the credential was issued.

authentic_source_id.description: Identifier of the public sector body or private entity responsible for the authentic source that is the primary source of the information or is recognized as authentic in national law.

authentic_source_name.description: Name of the public sector body or private entity responsible for the authentic source that is the primary source of the information or is recognized as authentic in national law.

iss.description: Issuer of the attestation, as an HTTPS URL that identifies the issuer.

iat.description: Time of issuance as a NumericDate (seconds since the Unix epoch).

nbf.description: Time before which the attestation is not valid, as a NumericDate.

exp.description: Time at which the attestation expires, as a NumericDate.

cnf.description: Confirmation claim that binds the attestation to the key of the holder (RFC 7800).

jwk.description: Public key of the holder as a JWK.

status.description: Reference to the Token Status List entry that carries the revocation status of the attestation.

idx.description: Index of the attestation in the status list.

uri.description: URI of the status list token.
